theme: 3 terms on enums in depth: a pattern that matches one case and pulls out its values, an enum that contains itself, and the keyword that lets it compile

terms.definition: A pattern like `.circle(let r)` that matches one enum case and pulls out its associated values.
terms.example: Use an Enum Case Pattern in `if case`, you don't need a full `switch` here.

terms.definition: An enum with a case that holds a value of the same enum, like a folder that holds folders.
terms.example: The comment thread is a Recursive Enum, so replies can hold replies.

terms.definition: An enum, or a single case, marked `indirect`, so Swift stores the nested values behind a pointer.
terms.example: Make it an Indirect Enum, otherwise the compiler can't work out its size.

video.title: Enum Case Pattern, Recursive Enum & Indirect Enum | Day 66
video.description:
Learn to explain enums in depth: Enum Case Pattern, Recursive Enum & Indirect Enum, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Enum Case Pattern - A pattern like `.circle(let r)` that matches one enum case and pulls out its associated values.
Recursive Enum - An enum with a case that holds a value of the same enum, like a folder that holds folders.
Indirect Enum - An enum, or a single case, marked `indirect`, so Swift stores the nested values behind a pointer.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift Enum Case Pattern, Recursive Enum & Indirect Enum | Day 66
landscape.description:
Explain Enum Case Pattern, Recursive Enum & Indirect Enum in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
열거형 케이스 패턴, 재귀 열거형, indirect 열거형 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Enum Case Pattern - A pattern like `.circle(let r)` that matches one enum case and pulls out its associated values.
한국어: 열거형 케이스 패턴: `.circle(let r)`처럼 열거형의 한 케이스와 맞춰 보고 연관값을 꺼내는 패턴

Recursive Enum - An enum with a case that holds a value of the same enum, like a folder that holds folders.
한국어: 재귀 열거형: 폴더 안의 폴더처럼, 케이스가 같은 열거형의 값을 담는 열거형

Indirect Enum - An enum, or a single case, marked `indirect`, so Swift stores the nested values behind a pointer.
한국어: indirect 열거형: `indirect`로 표시해서 Swift가 중첩된 값을 포인터 뒤에 저장하게 한 열거형이나 케이스

In this video, Mina and Jake find out why a message type that holds replies would not compile, how one keyword fixes it and how to read only the replies, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: An enum inside itself? Can you explain it in English?

dialogue.title: An enum inside itself?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: `reply` holds another `Msg`. That makes it a Recursive Enum.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: An enum inside itself? Sounds endless.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The compiler thinks so too. It can't work out the size of a Recursive Enum.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. An Indirect Enum stores those cases on the heap, behind a pointer.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I need an Indirect Enum for every case?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, you can mark just `reply`. The whole enum is simply shorter.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the `if case` line reads only replies?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. That's an Enum Case Pattern. It matches `reply` and pulls out `t`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. An Enum Case Pattern picks a case, and `indirect` lets it nest.
An Enum Case Pattern matches one case and grabs its values.
